## Episode Thesis

This Danish housing-market podcast from Børsen, sponsored by Saxo Bank, looks at house prices outside Copenhagen. Prices are up 6.9% nationally in the first nine months, and some municipalities such as Sorø and Guldborgsund are up 18-22%. Monthly price gains have slowed steadily, from 1.4% in May to 0.3% in September, and sales are down. The housing economist expects the rate of price growth to peak this year, with smaller gains next year as rising interest rates, higher property taxes and a possible cap on interest deductions weigh on the market. No listed equities are discussed beyond the sponsor mention.
